mapper.select: SELECT REVIEW_NO , RATING , CONTENT , RESERVE_NO FROM REVIEW ORDER BY REVIEW_DATE DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1) AS avgRating, SUM(CASE WHEN RATING = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS star5, SUM(CASE WHEN RATING = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS star4, SUM(CASE WHEN RATING <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS star3Below FROM REVIEW
